meta.description: Registry for Phase 2 operational stability test cases and iteration rules.

test_cases.expected_outcome: transition from non-participating to participating or vice versa

stability_dimensions.name: null_boundary_stability
stability_dimensions.question: Does participation classification remain stable under small perturbations near epsilon_null?

stability_dimensions.name: admissible_transition_stability
stability_dimensions.question: Do continuation legality decisions remain bounded under small changes in residue, orientation, and admissibility window?

stability_dimensions.name: recursive_coupling_stability
stability_dimensions.question: Does recursive residue-mediated coupling preserve or lose stabilized recurrence under iteration?

stability_dimensions.name: boundary_collapse_detection
stability_dimensions.question: Do admissibility windows collapse to empty or degenerate sets?

stability_dimensions.name: residue_sensitivity
stability_dimensions.question: How sensitive are continuation and coupling decisions to residue variation?

stability_dimensions.name: iteration_consistency
stability_dimensions.question: Do repeated applications preserve declared object classes and closure boundaries?
